evals.name: should-trigger-pr-review-lead-1
evals.prompt: Review the test automation PR upex-galaxy/some-repo#42 and give me feedback for the author.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates pr-review-lead on an external repo PR, drafts feedback citing doctrine or code.

evals.name: should-trigger-pr-review-lead-2
evals.prompt: Audit this PR from my teammate and score it against our KATA doctrine.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates pr-review-lead and grades the PR against KATA.

evals.name: should-trigger-pr-review-lead-3
evals.prompt: revisá este PR de automatización y dame feedback para el que lo abrió
evals.expected_behavior: Activates pr-review-lead in any language and drafts the review without posting.

evals.name: should-trigger-pr-review-lead-4
evals.prompt: calificá el PR de mi compañero contra las reglas KATA, sin postear nada todavía
evals.expected_behavior: Activates pr-review-lead; drafts and holds posting until a go.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-pr-review-lead-5
evals.prompt: Review my own uncommitted changes before I commit.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not use pr-review-lead: your own diff is code-review.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-pr-review-lead-6
evals.prompt: Run a blind dual review of this patch with two independent judges.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not use pr-review-lead: a blind verdict is judgment-day.
